rationale: Exceptional beat-and-accelerate quarter. Revenue doubled YoY to $1.3B, EPS more than tripled, 75% incremental adjusted EBITDA margins. Record $20B net deposits in Q3 already exceeding all of 2024. Prediction Markets is fastest $100M+ run-rate business ever and scaling to $300M based on October volumes (October alone bigger than all of Q3). Multiple new growth vectors launching: Banking, Ventures, Social, smart exchange routing. Management provides specific upbeat Q4 update - 'October was a strong month, new records across equities, options, prediction markets.' Vlad's tone is highly confident with specific forward catalysts (AI event Dec 16, Robinhood Ventures public offering). CFO retirement is offset by named, 7-year insider successor. Confident Q&A, direct answers on competitive dynamics, multiple $100M+ businesses diversifying away from concentration risk.

EPS beat trivially low bar ($0.23 vs $0.02 expected) but Q4 guide is concerning: flat sequential revenue, gross margin down to 36.5%, EPS guided to only $0.08 - a big sequential step-down. CFO explicitly says Q1 2026 will likely be 'peak shortage' unable to meet demand and 'not sure we'll buck seasonality.' 18A yields still 'not where we need to be' until end of 2026. Foundry still at negative gross margins with $2.3B operating loss. 'Rebuild' narrative with 'long way to go' language from CEO. Heavy capital dependence on US government, NVIDIA, SoftBank stakes. Hedging Q&A answers from CFO on gross margin recovery ('blazing new trail', 'multiyear process'). Capacity constraints limiting upside despite demand, but newer AI products not being adopted - customers prefer older nodes. Positive drivers (NVIDIA deal, balance sheet repair) are multi-year stories, not 30-day catalysts. Momentum likely to fade as Q4 guidance absorbs.

Strong beat ($0.66 vs $0.45), record $2.1T AUM, best flow quarter since 2021 with 8% annualized organic growth. Operating margin expanded 300bps sequentially to 34.2% with 480bps positive operating leverage. China JV exceptional at +34% annualized, 16% QoQ AUM growth. Balance sheet deleveraging ahead of schedule (25% of term loans repaid, $14.8M preferred dividend reduction captured). ETF platform hit $1T AUM milestone with 15% organic growth. Confident forward tone on multiple growth vectors (Barings partnership, MSM), and India divestiture monetizes capital. Key negatives: $5B fundamental equity outflows (including $4.5B developing markets), QQQ restructure vote delayed to Dec 5 (execution risk overhang), weakening bank loan flows in October, and Allison noting 'markets been a little bit jittery on credit side' in October. More positive than negative signals but QQQ vote overhang and equity outflows temper full conviction.

Strong beat-and-raise with 5.4% operational growth despite ~640bps STELARA LOE headwind - 'unequivocally answered' the bear thesis. 11 brands growing double digits. TREMFYA +40%, DARZALEX +20%, Carvicti +81%, SPRAVATO +61% - breadth is striking. MedTech accelerating to +5.6% with cardiovascular +12%, Shockwave +20.9%, Abiomed +15.6%. Raised full-year guide by $300M. Most importantly, CFO explicitly signals consensus 2026 growth of 4.6% is low and 'we project...will exceed 5%' with EPS upside of $0.05+. Orthopedics spin-off announced as near-term catalyst lifting 75bps+ growth and margins. Pipeline rich with catalysts - Inlexo launch ($5B peak asset), icotrokinra submission, CAPLYTA expansion, Ottava FDA filing early 2026. Management tone remarkably confident ('new era of accelerated growth', 'balance of the decade'). Direct Q&A with specific numbers. Talc litigation backdrop stabilized. Beat-and-raise with forward guidance upgrade and multi-year narrative - strong momentum continuation signal.

Outstanding finish to FY25: Q4 orders +14%, revenue +10%, EPS +16%, all above high end of guidance. Full-year orders and revenue +8%, EPS +14%, surpassing long-term model. FY26 guide: ex-acquisitions 10% revenue growth, at or above high end of 5-7% long-term target. Three strategic acquisitions closing (Spirent, Synopsys Optical, ANSYS PowerArtist) with $375M revenue contribution and $100M+ synergies targeted. Wireline business hit record with double-digit growth. AI infrastructure demand driving 'pipeline looks very robust' with improving velocity and conversion rates. Record A&D orders, defense modernization tailwind. Tariffs fully mitigated one quarter ahead of schedule. Board authorized additional $1.5B buyback. Management tone confident and specific with multiple named customer wins (Broadcom 1.6T validation, Meta partnership). Direct Q&A answers about R&D investments and long-term positioning. Software/services growing to 37% of revenue with more upside. Clean beat-and-raise with multi-year AI infrastructure tailwinds. Mild EPS dilution from M&A is near-term but accretion ramps through FY26.
